metadata.note: Machine-readable mirror of docs/DATA_SOURCES.md's distinct upstream organizations -- the landing page's 'Verified Sources' stat counts this array's length rather than a typed-in number. Keep this in sync by hand whenever an integration is added to or removed from DATA_SOURCES.md.

sources.name: India Meteorological Department (IMD)
sources.provides: Climate indices (heatwave, SPI, ETCCDI) for 5 Madhya Pradesh districts

sources.name: UNDP DiCRA
sources.provides: District NDVI zonal statistics, Madhya Pradesh only

sources.name: MODIS MOD13Q1 v061 (via Google Earth Engine)
sources.provides: District NDVI outside Madhya Pradesh, real per-year satellite composite (Phase 8.4)

sources.name: ERA5-Land (ECMWF) + CHIRPS (UCSB), via Google Earth Engine
sources.provides: National climate indices beyond the 5 IMD districts (Phase 3), and cross-source validation against IMD for those 5 districts (Phase 8.6)

sources.name: Survey of India, via National Water Data Portal (NWDP)
sources.provides: State, district, block and village boundaries plus village profile attributes, all 36 states/UTs

sources.name: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (data.gov.in)
Directorate of Economics and Statistics (DES), Dept. of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
sources.provides: District/season crop area, production, yield -- the portal's primary national crop-statistics source, 2000-01 to 2022-23

sources.name: ERA5-Land (ECMWF, via Google Earth Engine)
sources.provides: Tmax/Tmin for climate indices, districts beyond the 5 IMD districts

sources.name: CHIRPS (UCSB Climate Hazards Center, via Google Earth Engine)
sources.provides: Precipitation for climate indices, districts beyond the 5 IMD districts

sources.name: NASA POWER
sources.provides: Recent daily point weather (Live Weather panel) -- satellite/reanalysis, ~2-3 day reporting lag, not a live station feed

sources.name: ICRISAT District-Level Data (Mendeley Data)
sources.provides: 20-state, 560-district crop yield panel, 1990-2015, used as a regression sanity bound
